study_identification_part.si4_title: Comprehensive volumetric phenotyping of the neonatal brain in Down syndrome

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study aims to conduct a detailed regional volumetric analysis of the neonatal brain in Down syndrome (DS) using normative modeling to quantify deviations from a control cohort. It also aims to assess the impact of congenital heart defects (CHD) on these volumes.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this study, we aimed to conduct the first detailed regional volumetric analysis of the neonatal brain in DS. We used a robust cross-sectional sample of 493 pretermto term-born control neonates from the developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP) to perform normative modeling of regional brain tissue volumes... Deviation from the normative mean was quantified in 25 neonates with DS... In future, the ability to assess phenotypic severity at the neonatal stage may help guide early interventions...

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study describes the selection criteria for the reference cohort (dHCP neonates), including sample size (493), exclusion criteria (incidental findings, Bayley III scores < 70), and inclusion of healthy twins. Image quality standards are implied through the exclusion of scans with major lesions and the use of motion correction.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: A total of 493 preterm- to term-born neonates... were selected from the dHCP... Exclusion criteria included incidental findings on MRI... and Bayley III Scales of Infant Development... below 70... Healthy neonates from twin pregnancies were included... Exclusion criteria... incidental findings... including acute infarction or parenchymal hemorrhage, and major lesions...
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.location: Materials and methods - Participants / MR image review

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The GPR model accounted for sex and age (PMA). Site effects were not applicable as data was acquired on a single system.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: GPR was used to model the development... from 32 to 46 weeks PMA... accounting for modeled covariates... accounting for sex, PMA at scan... and age from birth variables. ... Neonatal MRI data were acquired on a Philips Achieva 3 Tesla system... at the Evelina Newborn Imaging Centre...
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.location: Materials and methods - Normative modeling using Gaussian process regression / MRI acquisition
